system.description:
Advanced Move. While you forcefully hold a creature, it is helpless unless it's particularly large or strong, and even then it is hampered and/or distracted by you.

When you forcefully grab or tackle a foe, roll+STR.

success.label: Success!
success.value: You have a good hold of them.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: They struggle for a bit at first, inflicting a condition before you get a good hold.
